verdict.rationale: Ramp's own site cites a customer case study (AIRCO) reporting full onboarding in 1 week versus 6 months on a prior platform. Ramp also offers Checking/Treasury banking products and a partner Applications API that pre-fills sign-up, so the story's axis applies. However, the timeline rests on a single vendor-curated anecdote, and it is unclear whether that onboarding covered banking specifically. Missing for 10: a documented onboarding process or typical time-to-live for Ramp banking/treasury, independent or community corroboration of week-scale onboarding, and evidence that the 1-week figure applies to banking rather than spend management alone.
